# Evergreen Office Cleaning

> Commercial and office cleaning in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area since 1989: recurring after-hours janitorial contracts, building maintenance and floor care, and one-off specialty cleaning for offices, clinics, managed buildings, retail and industrial sites.

- Address: 243 Queen St W., Toronto, ON M5V 1Z4, Canada
- Phone: (416) 803-4880
- Email: info@evergreencleaningservice.ca
- Founded: 1989. Formerly known as Evergreen Cleaning Service.
- Areas served: Toronto (including North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, East York and York), Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Pickering, Ajax and Oshawa.
- Insured and covered: bonded, liability insurance, WSIB Ontario; cleaning staff undergo background screening.
- How work is priced: after a free on-site walkthrough, with a written proposal. Replies to quote requests within 2 hours.
- Products: Armstrong Manufacturing ProSeries Green, third-party certified to UL Environment (ECOLOGO) standards.

## Services

- [Office cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/office-cleaning/): recurring after-hours cleaning by a consistent crew.
- [Commercial cleaning and janitorial services](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/commercial-cleaning/): retail, institutional and mixed-use premises; routine and periodic work.
- [Building maintenance and floor care](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/building-maintenance/): strip and wax, carpet extraction, high dusting, glass, pressure washing.
- [Floor stripping and waxing](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/floor-stripping-waxing/)
- [Industrial and warehouse cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/industrial-cleaning/)
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/post-construction-cleaning/)
- [Disinfection cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/disinfection-cleaning/)
- [Emergency cleaning](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/emergency-cleaning/)
- [Pressure washing](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/pressure-washing/)
- [Graffiti removal](https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/services/graffiti-removal/)
